steps.title: Extract

recipes.title: ONA Coffee — Raspberry Candy Filter V60
recipes.title_ar: أونا كوفي — رازبيري كاندي فلتر: V60
recipes.notes: Five 60 g pours. Later pours are triggered by drainage, not by an invented fixed schedule. Source method tags are not additional recipes.
recipes.notes_ar: خمس صبات، كل منها 60 g. الصبات اللاحقة بعد تصريف الماء؛ لا يحدد المصدر مواعيد ثابتة لها. وسوم الأدوات العامة ليست وصفات إضافية.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.description: Use 20 g coffee in a V60 and prepare 300 g water at 91°C.
steps.description_ar: استخدم 20 g بن في V60 وجهز 300 g ماء عند 91°C.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.description: Add 60 g water and bloom for 35 seconds.
steps.description_ar: أضف 60 g ماء وانتظر 35 ثانية للتزهير.

steps.title: Four further pours
steps.description: Add 60 g four more times, allowing each pour to drain before adding the next. Total water is 300 g.
steps.description_ar: أضف 60 g أربع مرات أخرى مع انتظار تصريف كل صبة قبل التالية. مجموع الماء 300 g.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Aim to finish the brew at 2:45.
steps.description_ar: استهدف انتهاء التحضير عند 2:45.

manual.pour_trigger_after_bloom: Wait for the preceding water to drain before the next pour.

recipes.title: Kurasu — Kenya Kangocho AA Japanese flash-brew comparison
recipes.title_ar: كوراسو — كينيا كانغوتشو إيه إيه: وصفة مقارنة يابانية مثلجة
recipes.grinder_setting: Finer than a standard hot pour-over
recipes.notes: The 150 g is hot brewing water; 65–70 g ice is separate. Source provides no water temperature or dripper model. Same recipe is shared with Brazil João Hamilton. Finish at approximately 1:40–1:45, then melt all ice before serving.
recipes.notes_ar: 150 g كمية ماء التحضير الساخن؛ الثلج 65–70 g منفصل. لا يذكر المصدر حرارة الماء أو طراز القمع. الوصفة مشتركة مع البرازيل جواو هاميلتون. تنتهي تقريباً عند 1:40–1:45، ثم يُذاب كل الثلج قبل التقديم.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.description: Rinse the paper and warm the dripper. Put 65–70 g ice in the server and 15 g ground coffee in the dripper.
steps.description_ar: اشطف الورق وسخن القمع. ضع 65–70 g ثلج في الإبريق و15 g بن مطحون في القمع.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.description: At 0:00, add 40 g hot water.
steps.description_ar: عند 0:00 أضف 40 g ماء ساخن.

steps.title: Second pour
steps.description: At 0:40, add 60 g to reach 100 g total water.
steps.description_ar: عند 0:40 أضف 60 g ليصبح مجموع الماء 100 g.

steps.title: Final pour
steps.description: At 1:10, gently add 50 g to reach 150 g total; avoid excessive agitation.
steps.description_ar: عند 1:10 أضف 50 g بهدوء ليصبح مجموع الماء 150 g، مع تجنب التحريك الزائد.

steps.title: Finish and mix
steps.description: Finish around 1:40–1:45, remove the dripper and stir until all ice melts.
steps.description_ar: أنه التحضير قرب 1:40–1:45، وارفع القمع وحرك المشروب حتى يذوب كل الثلج.

recipes.notes_ar: 40 g هو الناتج الاسمي المنشور بهامش ±2 g. الزمن يبقى 28–32 ثانية. وسوم الملاءمة للفرنش برس والموكا لا تتضمن وصفات إضافية.

steps.title: Dose
steps.description: Weigh 20 g of this coffee for espresso. Set the water temperature to 94°C.
steps.description_ar: زِن 20 g من هذا البن للإسبريسو. اضبط حرارة الماء على 94°C.

steps.title: Extract
steps.description: Extract to 40 g beverage output in 28–32 seconds.
steps.description_ar: استخلص 40 g من المشروب خلال 28–32 ثانية.

manual.editorial_step_basis: Bilingual steps restate published measurements; no detailed preparation sequence or missing timings were supplied by the source.

excluded.reason: The captured official guide publishes 212 seconds for 20.3 g → 44 g espresso at 93.5°C. This suspicious value is excluded; it has not been silently changed to 21 or 22 seconds.
Same-name Risaralda Washed rows disagree (21.5 g → 48 g / 30 s versus 21.5 g → 44 g / 28 s); the Veer Attikan row lists 9.5°C. These rows are excluded without correction.
General espresso table gives 29 s; product recipe gives 30 s at the same 22 g → 44 g / 94.5°C.
General table gives 22 g → 44 g / 29 s / 95°C; product gives 22 g → 44 g / 30 s / 94.5°C.
General table gives 21.5 g → 48 g / 29 s; product gives 22 g → 44 g / 30 s, both at 94.5°C.
Umoja Natural table gives 21 g → 42 g / 26 s / 95°C; captured natural-product recipe gives 21.5 g → 42 g / 28 s / 94.5°C. This is distinct from the included Umoja Washed.
Recipe heading has no usable dose, output, time or temperature in the captured page; metadata image filename also refers to a filter version. No parameters were invented.
Only an espresso ratio of 1:2.5 was captured; no coffee dose, time or temperature. Not included as a complete actionable recipe.
Brunswick card has exactly the same 24 g / 26 s and roast-age yields as Broadway. Both named coffees are retained, with a single canonical Broadway/Brunswick recipe.

Fritz current basket-area formulas and flow-dependent times differ from older named-blend basket tables. For example Old Dog older 18 g basket advice uses 16–17 g → 40–44 g, while the current formulas yield 34–38 g at those doses. No silent choice of guide version was made.
Article names two coffees and gives 200 g in 40+60+50+50 g pours, but omits coffee dose, water temperature and final time. Missing values were not borrowed from the May recipe.
Method guide blocks are reused on multiple product pages; not counted as additional uniquely coffee-specific recipes in this curated batch.

Located locale-specific generic ORIGAMI instructions differ (English 14.5 g / 260 g / four pours versus Japanese 15 g / 240 g / three pours); this research did not establish a single matching coffee-specific variant.
Official-source search found general method guides, without a verified additional coffee-specific recipe for this batch. This is not a claim that none exist.
Official-source search found general guides; no additional named-coffee recipe was sufficiently verified for this batch.
